summary: The RptStaffList document is a web user control for generating staff reports in an application. It includes functionalities for handling page events, executing a report generation command, and setting up JavaScript for the front-end interaction.
purpose: The purpose of RptStaffList is to provide a user interface for generating staff reports based on selected department criteria.

workflows.name: Page Load and Initialization
steps: Check if it's not a postback or first load.
Retrieve departments based on user's session and agency ID.
Bind department data to the dropdown on first load.

workflows.name: Run Report Command
steps: Add error message if no roles are selected.
Create a job to generate the staff report with selected options.

workflows.name: Pre Render Page
steps: Disable report generation if viewing as a different user.

business_rules: User must have at least one staff role selected to run reports.
conditions: User role checks for report generation.
system_behavior: Configures JavaScript for UI elements during async postbacks or full page loads.
Controls visibility of the report generation button when in user view mode.
dependencies: Departments data retrieval based on user's permissions.
exceptions: No roles selected exception prevents report generation.
